"""Invalid-request cases must return exactly {"error":"invalid_request"} exit 0."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
import harness

base = {
  "capacity": {"range": 2, "exact": 2},
  "releases": [{
    "id": "m", "classes": 1, "width": 2, "eps": [1, 1], "ratio": [1, 1],
    "threshold": [1, 1], "mode": "range", "packet_limit": 2, "idle_us": 0,
    "discovery": [{"class": 0, "values": [1515, 1615], "activation": [0, 5]}],
    "train": [{"class": 0, "values": [1515, 1615]}],
    "validation": [{"class": 0, "values": [1515, 1615]}]}],
  "blocks": []}

def mutate(fn):
    import copy
    r = copy.deepcopy(base)
    fn(r)
    return r

cases = []  # (name, raw bytes)

cases.append(("not-json", b"{"))
cases.append(("empty", b""))
cases.append(("trailing", json.dumps(base).encode() + b"{}"))
cases.append(("dup-key", b'{"capacity":{},"capacity":{},"releases":[],"blocks":[]}'))
cases.append(("nan", b'{"capacity":{"range":NaN,"exact":0},"releases":[],"blocks":[]}'))
cases.append(("float-int", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['capacity'].__setitem__('range', 1.0))).encode()))
cases.append(("exp-int", b'{"capacity":{"range":1e0,"exact":0},"releases":[],"blocks":[]}'))
cases.append(("bool-int", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['capacity'].__setitem__('range', True))).encode()))
cases.append(("neg-cap", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['capacity'].__setitem__('range', -1))).encode()))
cases.append(("big-cap", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['capacity'].__setitem__('exact', 8193))).encode()))
cases.append(("extra-root", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('x', 1))).encode()))
cases.append(("extra-rel-key", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('zz', 1))).encode()))
cases.append(("extra-row-key", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0]['train'][0].__setitem__('act', []))).encode()))
cases.append(("no-releases", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('releases', []))).encode()))
cases.append(("bad-id", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('id', 'a b'))).encode()))
cases.append(("bad-mode", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('mode', 'both'))).encode()))
cases.append(("ratio>1", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('ratio', [2, 1]))).encode()))
cases.append(("ratio-q0", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('ratio', [1, 0]))).encode()))
cases.append(("classes0", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('classes', 0))).encode()))
cases.append(("width1", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('width', 1))).encode()))
cases.append(("pl-small", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('packet_limit', 1))).encode()))
cases.append(("disc-len1", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0]['discovery'][0].__setitem__('values', [1515]))).encode()))
cases.append(("act-mismatch", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0]['discovery'][0].__setitem__('activation', [0]))).encode()))
cases.append(("act-big", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0]['discovery'][0].__setitem__('activation', [0, 1000001]))).encode()))
cases.append(("val-pad-mid", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0]['train'][0].__setitem__('values', [1514, 1515]))).encode()))
cases.append(("val-oob", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0]['train'][0].__setitem__('values', [3029, 1515]))).encode()))
cases.append(("train-missing-class", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0].__setitem__('train', [{'class': 0, 'values': []}, {'class': 1, 'values': []}]))).encode()))
cases.append(("bad-op", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('blocks', [[['fly', 'f']]]))).encode()))
cases.append(("bad-op-len", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('blocks', [[['open', 'f', 1]]]))).encode()))
cases.append(("install-unknown", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('blocks', [[['install', 'zz']]]))).encode()))
cases.append(("packet-bool-src", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('blocks', [[['packet', 'f', 0, True, 5]]]))).encode()))
cases.append(("packet-len0", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('blocks', [[['packet', 'f', 0, 0, 0]]]))).encode()))
cases.append(("packet-ts-big", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('blocks', [[['packet', 'f', 10**13, 0, 5]]]))).encode()))
cases.append(("float-value", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0]['train'][0].__setitem__('values', [1.0, 2]))).encode()))
cases.append(("null-value", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'][0]['train'][0].__setitem__('values', [None, 2]))).encode()))
cases.append(("dup-id", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r['releases'].append(dict(r['releases'][0])))).encode()))
cases.append(("bad-blocks-type", json.dumps(mutate(lambda r: r.__setitem__('blocks', {}))).encode()))
cases.append(("too-deep", b'[' * 33 + b']' * 33))

fails = 0
for name, raw in cases:
    rc, out = harness.run_subprocess(raw)
    ok = (rc == 0 and out.strip() == '{"error":"invalid_request"}')
    if not ok:
        fails += 1
        print('FAIL', name, 'rc=%d out=%r' % (rc, out[:200]))
    else:
        print('ok', name)
print('invalid-case fails =', fails)
